recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take with or without food
mechanism_of_action: helps your body respond better to insulin produced by your pancreas
side_effects: dizziness, asthenia, headache, nausea, severe skin rash, itching, redness, or irritation, pale skin, easy bruising or bleeding, fever, unusual weakness, upper stomach pain, low fever, jaundice (yellowing of the skin or eyes), nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, feeling restless or irritable, confusion, hallucinations, muscle pain or weakness, and/or seizure
unsuitable_population: children, elderly, pregnant women, patients with renal impairment, patients with glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency (G6PD), under-nourished individuals
storage_conditions: store at room temperature || keep tightly closed
